# Krishnendu Roy — Portfolio (Architecting Signal & Agentic AI)

> Full-stack software engineer and Computer Science & Engineering student at Academy of Technology, Kolkata, exploring agentic AI, graph systems, and spec-driven development.

## Who
Krishnendu Roy — second-year B.Tech CSE student, Academy of Technology. Started in front-end development, scaled into full-stack product development, and actively builds agentic AI workflows with strict spec-driven engineering. Also experienced in public relations, collegiate event coordination, and team leadership.

## Technical Capabilities
- Languages & Core: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SQL
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Responsive UI/UX, Micro-interactions, Tailwind CSS
- Backend & Databases: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, REST APIs, WebSockets
- Specialized Domains: Leaflet.js, OpenStreetMap, Graph Analysis, Agentic AI, LLM Tooling
- Methodologies: Spec-driven development, Human-in-the-loop verification, 60FPS UI performance
